propDocs.Resizable.orientation: Horizontal panels sit side by side; vertical panels stack.
propDocs.Resizable.disabled: Disables every handle and removes them from the tab order.
propDocs.ResizablePanel.defaultSize: Initial panel size as a percentage or CSS length.
propDocs.ResizablePanel.collapsible: Allows dragging, Enter or double-click to collapse below the minimum.
propDocs.ResizablePanel.collapsedSize: Size of the collapsed panel; zero also hides its content from focus and accessibility.
propDocs.ResizableHandle.children: Omit for the default grip, or pass null for a bare divider.
